title: An open competition for biomarkers of aging

fields.title: An open competition for biomarkers of aging
fields.authors: Ying, K., Paulson, S., Reinhard, J., …, Gladyshev, V. N.
fields.description: The Biomarkers of Aging Challenge was an open two-phase competition on blinded blood DNA-methylation and proteomic data from 500 Mass General Brigham Biobank participants. Models from the competing teams predicted chronological age more accurately than published clocks. A proteomic model predicted all-cause mortality better than GrimAge.
